sobre: Ficha de criação da arte da Ilha do Farol. Cada peça tem o prompt exato, o modelo e onde entra no jogo. Gerado no Kairogen; processado por arte/processar.py.
estilo: Soft flat 2D vector illustration in a calm children's picture-book style, the same art style as the reference image: thick rounded simple shapes, very low detail, soft matte pastel colors, gentle light highlights, no hard outlines.
proibicoes: No text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no ground shadow, no sparkles, no glitter, no busy details.
fundo_branco: Isolated on a pure flat white background (#FFFFFF) with a generous empty margin all around.

pecas.prompt: The exact same character as the reference image: Lume, the baby octopus, with the same shape, proportions, big round eyes and six tentacles. Body color: light warm apricot (#EDB978). Expression: calm, content and relaxed, like after a slow deep breath: the same big round friendly eyes fully open with soft relaxed eyebrows curved gently upward, and a small gentle closed-mouth smile. Not sleepy, not bored, not half-closed eyes. Front view, full body, centered.

The exact same character as the reference image: Lume, the baby octopus, with the same shape, proportions, eyes and six tentacles. Body color changed to soft light blue (#86AACB). Expression: a little sad, inner eyebrows slightly raised, small gently downturned mouth, no tears. Front view, full body, centered.

The exact same character as the reference image: Lume, the baby octopus, with the same shape, proportions, eyes and six tentacles. Body color changed to soft coral (#D98466). Standing, three-quarter side view facing left, full body, centered.

Six separate simple flat pictogram icons for a communication board for young children, in one horizontal row, same size, evenly spaced with very wide empty gaps between them. From left to right: two open cupped hands reaching forward (meaning I want); two hands, one helping to lift the other (meaning help); a sound speaker with a small downward arrow (meaning quieter, please); a simple calm face with a small left-right arrow under it, like a gentle head shake (meaning no, thank you); a waving open hand with two small motion lines (meaning bye); an open door with an arrow going out (meaning I am leaving).

Six separate character portraits in one horizontal row, same size, evenly spaced with very wide empty gaps between them, using exactly the three characters from the reference images with the same colors and style (the turtle Tuca, the crab Caco with teal headphones, the seagull Gigi).
